continuity: Taekyung killed forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors alone in roughly fifteen minutes using an ordinary iron spear.
Won Myunghoon privately resents Taekyung's rejection and regards the Peace Guild as inferior; he ordered Kim Jonghun to find a boss monster or lure strong Wyverns.
Im Kkeokjeong was among the injured people Taekyung protected during an E-Rank Gate attack two years earlier and remains deeply grateful.
plot: Jin Taekyung detects forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors before the others and kills them all in about fifteen minutes with an ordinary iron spear. Won Myunghoon and Team Leader 1 are alarmed by his strength, while Won privately resents Taekyung's rejection of his offers and orders Jonghun to find a boss monster or lure strong Wyverns.

Im Kkeokjeong reveals that Taekyung once protected him during an E-Rank Gate attack, and Taekyung lends him Won's Yeti's Necklace. Team Leader Choi recognizes the item, prompting Taekyung to use Item Appraisal for the first time.
translation_decisions: Render 오크 as “Orc,” 오크 워리어 as “Orc Warrior,” 김종훈 as “Kim Jonghun,” 블라디미르 스탈린 as “Vladimir Stalin,” and 프로즌 아이 as “Frozen Eye.”

active_continuity: One Step Back granted Taekyung two level-ups and 20 Bonus Points.
Jeok Cheongang selected three Scorching Yang Qi elixirs for Taekyung's Fire Gate Clan training, and Taekyung successfully opened his Conception and Governor Vessels.
Taekyung is publicly recognized as Jeok Cheongang's Disciple and heir to the Fire Gate Clan's orthodox lineage.
Jin Mukyung remains secluded in the training hall and has not returned to Heaven's Gate Temple.
The Jin Family received an invitation to the Star-Array Grand Banquet in Henan.
Seong Jinho is staying at Taekyung's new family home after losing his housing deposit to Kim Jong-su.
Taekyung has achieved the A-Rank Hunter Achievement, leveled up, gained 20 Bonus Points, and received a major increase in Fame.
The tollgate Gate released ten B-rank ogres; Taekyung defeated them, blocked the arriving military team from taking the remaining monsters, and collected their valuable parts.
The Peace Guild House has extensive magical communication, observation, and alarm systems; its website has begun recruiting Guild members, and Team Leader Choi serves as its spokesperson.
Taekyung's identity and Hunter status are public, and his tollgate rescue made him nationally famous after his KPS Nine O'Clock News appearance.
The media frenzy exposed Taekyung's family's personal information; Taekyung feels burdened and guilty about the hero label.
Won Myunghoon is a thirty-nine-year-old A-rank Hunter, former ranker and celebrity entertainer, and current CEO of the Star Guild in Incheon.

Won Myunghoon's eight-year absence followed the Myeongdong Station Mutated Gate Catastrophe, where Do Minsu and around thirty others died; Won survived, was tried and cleared, and later retired from entertainment.
Taekyung and Won Myunghoon have a friendly hyung-and-younger-brother relationship; Taekyung declined Won's Star Guild and entertainment-agency proposals.
Taekyung and Team Leader Choi cleared The Lycanthrope's Black Forest after Taekyung defeated its Silver-Mane Lycanthrope boss.
A speculative report falsely claimed that Taekyung would transfer to the Star Guild; Won and the media outlet issued corrective statements.
Won arranged a joint Peace Guild–Star Guild raid on an A-Rank Gate, with the Star Guild holding permission and guaranteeing the Peace Guild rights to the drops.
The joint raid was accidentally redirected to The Black Wyvern's Nest; Taekyung insisted on proceeding despite his trauma, and a Lv. 97 Green Wyvern appeared before the group left the jungle area.

Won Myunghoon killed the Green Wyvern alone with an Aura-coated spear, and Taekyung received no EXP for making no contribution; Won lent Taekyung Yeti's Necklace, and Won and Team Leader 1 sought a stronger monster whose appearance would leave surviving witnesses.

Taekyung killed forty-seven B-Rank Orc Warriors alone with an ordinary iron spear; Won privately resents Taekyung's rejection, and Im Kkeokjeong was among those Taekyung rescued during an earlier E-Rank Gate attack.
open_questions: What are the rewards for the Conception Vessel Opening Achievement and the rare Achievement earned after completing the Conception and Governor Vessels Quest?
Will Jin Mukyung return to Heaven's Gate Temple before the appointed deadline?
What event does Jeok Cheongang believe may occur sooner than expected, and why must he endure for several more years?
What is the true condition of the absent Martial God?
Will Taekyung attend the Star-Array Grand Banquet, and what exactly was the answer that changed the three men's expressions?
What are the Reward and Failure conditions of the Gate Suppression Quest?
How will the Gate near Hwang Cheol Soo's tollgate ultimately be contained, and what further monsters may emerge?
What stronger monster will Won's Yeti's Necklace draw, and what will happen to the raid's surviving witnesses?
